description: This file defines a PHP class 'stashrestInterface' that integrates with a stash (Bitbucket Server) REST API for code tracking within a larger application, likely involving test management or issue tracking. It handles configuration, connection establishment, and data retrieval functions related to projects, repositories, branches, commits, and repository content.

classes.name: stashrestInterface
classes.description: Handles integration with the stash (Bitbucket server) REST API, managing configuration, connection, and data retrieval related to projects, repositories, branches, commits, and content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and attempts to connect to the stash API using provided configuration.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration array with default URI endpoints if missing.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client instance.

methods.name: getEnterCodeURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for entering code links.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the stash system, testing login and project existence.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating if the connection to stash is active.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves a project by its key.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves the list of projects.

methods.name: getProjectsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns projects formatted for HTML select options.

methods.name: getRepos
methods.description: Retrieves repositories for a given project.

methods.name: getReposForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns repositories formatted for HTML select options.

methods.name: getRepoContent
methods.description: Retrieves content of a repository at a specified path and branch.

methods.name: getRepoContentForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns repository content entries formatted for HTML select options.

methods.name: getBranches
methods.description: Retrieves branches for a project repository.

methods.name: getBranchesForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns branches formatted for HTML select options.

methods.name: getCommits
methods.description: Retrieves commits for a repository, optionally filtered by branch.

methods.name: getCommitsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns commits formatted for HTML select options with display info.

methods.name: objectAttrToKeyName
methods.description: Converts a set of attributes to a key-value array with formatted strings.

methods.name: objectAttrToIDName
methods.description: Converts a set of attributes to a key-value array based on specified id and name properties.

methods.name: objectAttrToIDNameKey
methods.description: Converts a set of attributes to a key-value array based on id, with name and key info.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template string for configuration with placeholders.

methods.name: checkCfg
methods.description: Validates the configuration object, especially the project key.
